events.text: Stored as a future-work idea (phone system is the gate, not built). Captured in memory project_qr_mission_delivery.md: missions/events delivered diegetically via in-world QR codes — billboard 'YOU WOULDNT DOWNLOAD A CAR ...but you would steal one' wired to the crime app, plus telephone-pole flyers (one-liner + QR) linking to random missions/events. Plugs into signage-prop text/decal channel + MissionDef (storyline board) when the phone exists. No code changed.

resolution: Idea-capture request, no code change. The user shared a missions-design idea seeded by a 'YOU WOULDNT DOWNLOAD A CAR' billboard prop they made: treat missions/events as diegetic, discoverable world content delivered through in-world QR codes rather than map markers — billboard expanded with '...but you would steal one' wired to the in-game crime app + a corner QR, plus scatterable telephone-pole flyers (one-liner + QR) linking to random missions/events. The user explicitly said the phone system isnt built yet and this is to STORE for later. Stored in persistent memory (project_qr_mission_delivery.md) + MEMORY.md index, cross-linked to project_signage_props (per-instance text/decal channel = the flyer surface), project_storyline_board (MissionDef = the scan target), and feedback_props_uniform_capability. The phone system is the documented gate. Nothing to build now.
